description: This is a Java unit test class for ProjectServiceImpl, testing CRUD operations on Project entities with Mockito.

classes.name: ProjectServiceImplUTest
classes.description: Unit test class for ProjectServiceImpl, testing methods for project CRUD operations.

methods.name: testCreateProjectShouldCreateProject
methods.description: Tests the creation of a project and verifies the saveProject method is called.

methods.name: testGetProjetcWithProjectIdShouldReturnProjectWithThatProjectId
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a project by ID and asserts the returned project matches expected.

methods.name: testUpdateProjectThatExistShouldUpdateProject
methods.description: Tests updating an existing project and verifies findProject and saveProject are called.

methods.name: testUpdateProjectThatDoesNotExistShouldThrowException
methods.description: Tests that updating a non-existent project throws a RuntimeException and saveProject isn't called.

methods.name: testDeleteExistingProjectShouldDeleteExistingProject
methods.description: Tests deletion of an existing project, verifying removeProject is called.

methods.name: testDeleteExistingProjectThatDoesNotExistShouldThrowException
methods.description: Tests that deleting a non-existent project throws RuntimeException.
